title: BA1/1765/2023 of TARANVEER SINGH Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
First Bail Application No. 1765 of 2023
Taranveer Singh ........Applicant

Present:-
Mr. Vipul Sharma, Advocate for the applicant.
Mr. Pramod Tiwari, Brief Holder for the State.
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)
 Applicant Taranveer Singh is in judicial
custody in FIR No.309 of 2023 dated 19.07.2023, under
Sections 307, 120-B IPC, Police Station Khatima, District
Udham Singh Nagar. He has sought his release on bail.
2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and
perused the record.
3. It is argued that the co-accused has already
been granted anticipatory bail in the instant case, who
was also named in the FIR.
4. According to the FIR, on 18.07.2023, when
the informant was riding on a Scooty along with
Rajinder, a car hit them from behind. The applicant
started assaulting the informant and thereafter, some

2
person joined him. Somehow, the informant escaped
himself.
5. Learned counsel for the informant would
submit that, in fact, the informant had lodged the FIR
under a designed; he had earlier filed protection in this
Court in WPCRL No.9867 of 2023, but it was so
obtained by playing fraud; that order was recalled by
this Court on 27.09.2023. It is also submitted that the
co-accused, who was not named in the FIR had already
been granted anticipatory bail by this Court in ABA
No.627 of 2023. It is also argued that the injury also
does not confirm by the prosecution case.
6. Learned State counsel would submit that the
co-accused, who was granted anticipatory bail was not
named in the FIR. The applicant is named in the FIR.
7. Having considered, this Court is of the view
that it is a case fit for bail and the applicant deserves to
be enlarged on bail.
8. The bail application is allowed.
9. Let the applicant be released on bail, on his
executing a personal bond and furnishing two reliable

3
sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the
court concerned.
 (Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 09.11.2023
Sanjay
